elements_selected.content: Implement verbose observability output per OBS-007, OBS-008, OBS-009. OBS-007 (zetl index --verbose): emit to stderr: files hashed / files skipped (mtime hit) / files with content-hash match (touch hit); total leaf nodes; SPL leaves with dual hashing; BLAKE3 hashing time (ms); section detection and grounding hash time (ms). OBS-008 (zetl check summary): add to summary JSON and table: total_spl_blocks, drifted_blocks_warning, drifted_blocks_info, explicitly_grounded_facts, broken_groundings. OBS-009 (zetl index --verbose and zetl reason status --verbose): emit cache efficiency stats: tier1_hits (mtime), tier1_misses, tier2_hits (hash match), tier2_misses (actual change), theory_cache_hit / theory_cache_miss. Add these counters to the scan/index pipeline. Output to stderr so JSON stdout is unaffected. Wire --verbose flag into cmd_index and cmd_reason_status in main.rs.
